title: Tool Selection Quality Not-Applicable Audit (Missing Tool Schemas)
dataSources: Span read-back from `AgentStream.get(...).get_spans(...)`: the evaluator status field `metrics_<uuid>_status` and `output_tool_calls`
description: Finds LLM spans that Tool Selection Quality cannot score because the agent did not log the available tools, so gaps in coverage are visible instead of hiding as not-applicable results.
value: A stream can look fully scored while most tool-choosing turns are skipped. Listing the not-applicable spans tells the team which code path forgot `tools=`.
implementation: Read recent spans back, find the Tool Selection Quality UUID through `metric_info_<uuid>_metric_key_alias`, and list spans whose status is not applicable while their output still contains tool calls. Fix the LLM span helper for those paths.
visualization: Read-back script output: count of not-applicable spans that made tool calls, per span name.
knownFalsePositives: Spans that offer no tools (classifiers, writers) are not applicable by design. Only spans whose output contains tool calls point to a logging gap.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites

A Splunk Agent Observability project for the application and one Agent Stream per environment or agent inside it. Do not create a second project for the same application: a second project splits the traces. The agent reads `SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT` and `SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM` from the environment. SaaS tenants authenticate with `SPLUNK_AO_REALM` and `SPLUNK_AO_O11Y_TOKEN`; on-prem tenants with `SPLUNK_AO_API_KEY` plus `SPLUNK_AO_CONSOLE_URL`. Install the SDK with `pip install splunk-ao` (`pip install "splunk-ao[langchain]"` for the LangChain callback).

Step 1 — Instrument the agent

The agent is already instrumented as described in UC-13.8.1: every request is a trace with at least one agent span, LLM spans carry `model`, token counts and the `tools` schemas, and tool spans carry `name`, `duration_ns` and `tool_call_id`.

Step 2 — Configure in Splunk Agent Observability

An LLM span without `tools` gets status `not_applicable` (code 2009, "requires the available tools to be logged on the LLM span"). The console shows it as not applicable, not as an error.

Step 3 — Validate

Run the script against the stream. The field names (`metrics_<uuid>_status`, `metric_info_<uuid>_metric_key_alias`) come from field testing on `splunk-ao` 0.6.1; recheck them on newer SDK versions. This use case was written from the Splunk Agent Observability documentation without access to a tenant, so it ships as a draft. Confirm each step in the Splunk Agent Observability console before promoting it.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Run the script after each release and treat a non-zero count of tool-calling, not-applicable spans as a bug in the LLM span helper.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

Every span not applicable: the shared LLM span helper drops `tools`. No UUID found: Tool Selection Quality is not enabled on this stream (check `get_metrics()`).
grandmaExplanation: We look for the times the reviewer could not grade the assistant's tool choice because we forgot to tell it which tools were on the shelf.

productArtifacts.title: List tool-calling LLM spans that were not scored
productArtifacts.body:
from splunk_ao import AgentStream

s = AgentStream.get(name=stream_name, project_name=project_name)
spans = s.get_spans(limit=500)

def tsq_uuid(span):
    for key, val in span.items():
        if key.startswith("metric_info_") and key.endswith("_metric_key_alias") \
                and val == "tool_selection_quality":
            return key[len("metric_info_"):-len("_metric_key_alias")]
    return None

gaps = []
for sp in spans:
    uid = tsq_uuid(sp)
    if uid and sp.get(f"metrics_{uid}_status") == "not_applicable" and sp.get("output_tool_calls"):
        gaps.append(sp.get("name"))
print(f"{len(gaps)} tool-calling LLM spans not scored (no tools= logged)")
